lessonActivities.title: This/That & These/Those – Proximity & Distance! 🎯
lessonActivities.content:
Welcome to demonstrative determiners! This/that and these/those show proximity and distance. 📍

Core Concept: Demonstratives indicate how close or far something is from the speaker.

Basic Rules:

  • This/these: Near the speaker (singular/plural)
  • That/those: Far from the speaker (singular/plural)
  • Physical distance: This room vs that room
  • Time distance: This week vs that week

Important Note: Demonstratives can change meaning based on context!

Common Mistakes: Mixing singular/plural forms or using wrong proximity.
examples: That book looks good too. (book far from speaker)
Those shoes are expensive. (shoes far from speaker)
lessonActivities.tips: 💡 Quick Rule: This/these = near me. That/those = far from me.

lessonActivities.title: This & That – Singular Demonstratives 📍
lessonActivities.content:
Master this and that with singular nouns. 📍

This (near):

  • Objects close to speaker
  • Current situations
  • Present time references
  • Introducing new information

That (far):

  • Objects away from speaker
  • Past situations
  • Distant time references
  • Previously mentioned items

Context Matters: Distance can be physical, temporal, or emotional.
examples: That problem was solved last week. (past issue)
That is Mary over there. (pointing to distant person)

lessonActivities.title: These & Those – Plural Demonstratives 👥
lessonActivities.content:
Learn these and those with plural nouns. 👥

These (near plural):

  • Multiple items close to speaker
  • Current group/situation
  • Present time plural references
  • Introducing new plural information

Those (far plural):

  • Multiple items away from speaker
  • Past/distant plural situations
  • Previously mentioned plural items
  • Distant groups

Advanced Tip: These/those can show emotional distance too.
examples: Those books look expensive. (books far from speaker)
These shoes fit perfectly. (trying on nearby shoes)
Those shoes are too big. (pointing to distant shoes)
lessonActivities.tips: 💡 Plural Rule: These = these ones here. Those = those ones there.

lessonActivities.title: Demonstratives as Pronouns – Standing Alone 🔍
lessonActivities.content:
Use demonstratives as pronouns without nouns. 🔍

As Pronouns:

  • This/these: Replace nearby nouns
  • That/those: Replace distant nouns
  • With 'one': This one, that one
  • With 'ones': These ones, those ones

Context Required: The noun must be clear from context.

Regional Note: Americans often add 'one' after demonstratives.
functions: Replacing nouns when clear from context
lessonActivities.tips: 💡 Pronoun Rule: This/these replace nearby nouns. That/those replace distant nouns.

lessonActivities.title: Time & Context with Demonstratives ⏰
lessonActivities.content:
Learn how demonstratives work with time and context. ⏰

Temporal Usage:

  • This: Present, current, immediate
  • That: Past, recent, just mentioned
  • These: Current period/group
  • Those: Past period/group

Context Changes: What 'near' means depends on situation.

Emotional Distance: Can show psychological closeness/farness.

lessonActivities.title: Mastering Demonstratives – Natural Communication 🏆
lessonActivities.content:
Put it all together! Use demonstratives naturally in conversation. 🏆

Communication Strategies:

  • Pointing: This is..., That is...
  • Choices: This one or that one?
  • Time: This week vs that week
  • Groups: These people vs those people

Advanced Tip: Demonstratives help create vivid, specific descriptions.
examples: This is the best restaurant in town. (nearby/current)
Those were the good old days. (past period)
I want this one, not that one. (specific choice)
These problems need solving now. (urgent current issues)
That reminds me of my childhood. (distant memory)
This is exactly what I need. (perfect current match)
lessonActivities.tips: 💡 Native Choice: Use demonstratives to make your speech more specific and vivid.

writingActivities.question: Write 5 sentences using 'this' and 'that' with singular nouns.
writingActivities.hint: Use this for nearby items, that for distant ones.

writingActivities.question: Write 5 sentences using 'these' and 'those' with plural nouns.
writingActivities.hint: Use these for nearby groups, those for distant groups.

writingActivities.question: Write sentences using demonstratives as pronouns (this/that/these/those alone).
writingActivities.hint: Use them when the noun is clear from context, often with 'one' or 'ones'.

writingActivities.question: Write sentences showing time differences with demonstratives.
writingActivities.hint: Use this/these for present/current, that/those for past.

writingActivities.question: Write sentences contrasting near vs far with demonstratives.
writingActivities.hint: Show the same type of thing in different locations using different demonstratives.
sentenceStarters: This book is good but that ___
This restaurant is near but that ___
These cars are new but those ___

writingActivities.question: Write a short dialogue (8-10 exchanges) using demonstratives naturally.
writingActivities.hint: Include pointing, choices, time references, and group distinctions.

writingActivities.question: Correct demonstrative mistakes in these sentences.
writingActivities.hint: Fix wrong proximity, singular/plural mismatches, or incorrect time usage.

writingActivities.question: Write descriptive paragraphs using demonstratives for vivid language.
writingActivities.hint: Use demonstratives to create specific, engaging descriptions of scenes or situations.

gameActivities.question: Choose the correct demonstrative for a nearby singular item.
gameActivities.hint: This is used for singular items near the speaker.

gameActivities.question: Select the correct demonstrative for distant plural items.
gameActivities.hint: Those is used for plural items far from the speaker.

gameActivities.question: Which demonstrative shows present time?
gameActivities.hint: This refers to present or current time.

gameActivities.question: Choose the correct pronoun form for nearby items.
gameActivities.hint: These is the plural pronoun for nearby items.

gameActivities.question: Which demonstrative cannot be used alone as a pronoun?
gameActivities.hint: All demonstratives can be used as pronouns, but context matters.

quizActivities.question: Which demonstrative is used for singular items near the speaker?
quizActivities.hint: This is for singular, nearby items.
quizActivities.explanation: This is used for singular nouns that are near the speaker.

quizActivities.question: Which demonstrative shows plural items far from the speaker?
quizActivities.hint: Those is for plural, distant items.
quizActivities.explanation: Those is used for plural nouns that are far from the speaker.

quizActivities.question: What's the difference between 'this' and 'that'?
quizActivities.hint: This is near, that is far.
quizActivities.explanation: This indicates proximity, that indicates distance.

quizActivities.question: Which sentence uses demonstratives correctly?
quizActivities.explanation: That book is correct - singular noun with singular demonstrative.

quizActivities.question: Which demonstrative can show emotional distance?
quizActivities.hint: That can show psychological or emotional distance.
quizActivities.explanation: That can indicate emotional distance or rejection of an idea.

spellingActivities.hint: Word that shows or points to something
spellingActivities.sentence: This, that, these, those are ____ determiners.

spellingActivities.hint: Related to the mind or emotions
